QuestInfo.name: Fungi Fever
QuestInfo.0: Word is, #m800000000# is plagued by some kind of evil fungus. #p9120003# might know more about it.
QuestInfo.1: Some mushrooms in #m800000000# have mutated into #o9400018#. It's like they're suffering from some kind of fungus... fungus! #p9120003# says it's made getting around town really dangerous. She needs you to get rid of #b#o9400018#s#k around the #b#m800000202##k. \n\n#o9400018# #r#a43091##k
QuestInfo.2: Your hard work has made #m800000000# safe once again, and the locals couldn't be more grateful!

0.0: The perpetually temperate weather here in #m801000000# has made it a prime spot to grow mushrooms for as long as I can remember. And that's a looong time. Don't believe me? Just look at how old I am!
0.1: Anyway, those humble little fungi have become a crucial part of the local economy and a sort of unofficial mascot here. The trouble lately is, several mushrooms have started acting strangely, and it's getting dangerous. Think you could help us?

yes.0: Ah, then you'll track down the blue mutant mushroom! Thanks! Just be careful. I don't know what's gotten into it, but it can get really nasty when it feels threatened.
yes.1: The #b#o9400018##k looks a lot like other mushrooms, but don't let that fool you. It's a real beast. Please get rid of it and make our town safe again.

no.0: No? I thought you were supposed to be some hotshot hero for the helpless...

1.0: You did it! I can't tell you how much of a problem that's been.

yes.0: On behalf of the entire town, I thank you for making our home safe again!
yes.1: Though, I'm worried we haven't seen the last of #o9400018#. Another one somehow shows up every day. Why don't you come back tomorrow and help me out again?

mob.0: You didn't get the #o9400018# out of the #m800000202#? How are the locals supposed to feel safe with that thing roaming loose?
